text:
"저 사람은 잘 되는데
왜 나는 *이 모양*일까"
en: "Why is it going so well for them, and I'm like this?"
C. S. Lewis put it this way:
Pride isn't about having more money.
It's about having more than the next person.

text:
경쟁이 없는 교만이
있을 수가 없죠

en: and always falls back into the pit.
Back and forth, up and down.

text:
이렇게 *열심히* 살았는데
왜 나는 이 모양이지?
en: "I worked so hard. Why am I like this?
Why is he doing so well?"
That resentment actually comes from you.

text:
그것을 깊이 알아야 되죠
왜 *당신 탓*이죠?
en: You need to see that. Why is it your fault?

text:
그 원인은 그 사람이
잘 살아서가 아닙니다

내가 나의 *행위*로 스스로
삶을 통제하려 했기 때문에
en: Because I tried to control my life by my own deeds:
